description.en: Adds a Robots page to the sidebar. A robot is a directory the plugin creates under ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots and mounts as a DSH workspace; only robots created here are managed. For each robot you can install project-level skills through npx skills, edit its AGENTS.md, open its conversation, or re-mount it after the workspace was removed. Every robot also has a preset avatar and a one-sentence responsibility statement (the read-only buka_robots tool returns it so workflows can choose the robot), and the plugin exposes the ctx.bukaRobots service (list, avatarMap, a blocking startSession and non-blocking dispatchSession / openSession with an observable handle; dispatchSession / openSession also accept an optional planMode flag that switches the session into DSH plan mode before the first prompt, and the handle can read / clear it; the service advertises supportsPlanMode; every robot session always submits a structured JSON result through the scoped structured_output tool, optionally constrained by outputSchema and, for workflow nodes, the outgoing route names, with bounded result retries and an optional abortable escape; sessions are normal runtime-root conversations under the normal approval policy). Installing the plugin also adds the robot-builder mode (an agent preset carried by its bundle patch): new sessions can pick 机器人构建, which asks what the robot should do, drafts its AGENTS.md, then creates and mounts the robot with the preset-only buka_robot_build tool. On a fresh install (an empty registry) the plugin seeds two preset robots — 软件工程师 (software engineer) and 质量保障工程师 (QA engineer) — as ordinary, editable robots.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏新增「机器人」页面。机器人是本插件在 ~/.cache/dsh-plugin-robots/robots 下创建并挂载成 DSH 工作区的目录，只有这里创建的机器人才归插件管理。每个机器人可以用 npx skills 安装项目级 skills、编辑自己的 AGENTS.md、一键打开会话；工作区被删掉后还能重新挂载。每个机器人还带一个预设头像（新建时自动分配，详情页可更换）与一句职责（对应 description 字段，类似 skill 的 description）：只读工具 buka_robots 会把它返回给编排器，工作流据此选择机器人。插件通过 ctx.bukaRobots 服务向其他插件（例如 Buka Workflows）开放 list()、avatarMap()、阻塞的 startSession() 与非阻塞的 dispatchSession() / openSession()（后者返回可观测句柄）；dispatchSession() / openSession() 还接受可选的 planMode：投递第一轮 prompt 之前把会话切到 DSH plan 模式，句柄可以读取 / 清除该模式；服务公开 supportsPlanMode 供工作流在启动前做能力检查；每个机器人会话都必须交回一个 JSON 结果（scoped 工具 structured_output，可传 outputSchema 与工作流出边名约束，错了有次数上限的追问，工作流节点可传 abortable 允许用 abort 主动终止）；会话是运行时根会话、走正常审批策略。安装插件还会多出一个「机器人构建」模式：新建会话时可选，它先问清机器人要做什么，起草 AGENTS.md，再用只对该模式可见的 buka_robot_build 工具创建并挂载机器人。全新安装（登记表为空）时插件会自动补上「软件工程师」与「质量保障工程师」两个预设机器人，它们与普通机器人一样可编辑、可删除。每个机器人都可以重命名：机器人目录会一并改名，登记表条目就地更新、DSH 工作区按新路径重建，已有会话日志保留但不再列在这个机器人下。
